title: Release Gatehouse: coordinated smoke + telemetry preflight for major upgrades
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define and implement a 'Gatehouse' preflight orchestration that runs lightweight smoke suites together with a focused telemetry and perf snapshotting step before any major runtime upgrades or LTS branch promotions. The goal is to catch obvious correctness regressions, detect performance drifts within 95% confidence bounds, and produce a compact roll-forward/rollback decision payload for the rollout controller.
background: We have multiple existing smoke and validation harnesses scattered across repos. Past upgrades surfaced regressions late because smoke runs were not consistently paired with standardized telemetry snapshots (P50/P95 latency, token cost, KV cache hit-rate). Gatehouse should unify orchestration, standardize metrics, and emit a small human-readable verdict + artifact bundle that can be attached to release notes or used by canary gates.
acceptance_criteria: Gatehouse workflow can be triggered by CI or manually with a single command that accepts a target version and LTS flag
Runs a configurable smoke suite covering: API connectivity, basic generation, embeddings sanity, KV cache hot-path, and healthcheck endpoints
Collects a standardized telemetry snapshot: token throughput, P50/P95 latency, memory usage, GPU util, KV cache hit-rate, and inferred cost per 1k tokens
Computes automated regressions: flags perf regressions when P95 latency increases > 15% and/or throughput drops > 12% with configurable thresholds
Produces an artifacts bundle (logs, telemetry JSON, failing test traces, verdict.md) uploaded to the release artifact store and linked from the Gatehouse run
Gatehouse verdict integrates with rollout controller to block canary promotion when critical failures or high-confidence perf regressions are detected
Documentation and runbook published in Confluence with example CLI usage and troubleshooting steps
tasks: Design Gatehouse orchestration API and CLI (fx: gatehouse run --target runtime-1.20 --lts)
Implement lightweight smoke test definitions and container images
Instrument telemetry probes and standardize metric names across services
Build snapshotter that collects and normalizes metrics into telemetry JSON
Implement regression detector and configurable threshold rules
Upload artifacts to release store and emit verdict summary
Integrate with rollout controller and add blocking policy for canary promotions
Create Confluence runbook and example automation in CI/CD pipeline
progress_updates: 2025-02-11: Kickoff meeting with infra, runtime, and console teams. Agreed scope: smoke + telemetry snapshot + verdict. Luis to prototype CLI wrapper.
2025-02-13: Prototype CLI scaffolding completed (internal branch). Smoke container image skeleton created. Identified existing smoke cases in infra repo to reuse.

2025-02-15: Telemetry schema draft v0.1 in this ticket. Decided on canonical metric names: redwood.request.p95_ms, redwood.kv.hit_rate, redwood.tokens.per_minute. Need runtime/metrics owners to emit matching labels.

2025-02-17: First end-to-end local run completed against canary dev cluster. Smoke suite ran in ~3 minutes; telemetry snapshot collected. Regression detector flagged a 18% P95 latency increase — investigation in progress.

2025-02-18: Root cause of latency bump traced to an unexpected kernel selection change in the runtime that increased CPU->GPU stalls under short sequences. Work item open with ENG-84211 to land optimized kernel fallback.
